about_the_game:
Upgrade your crew with Character Pass 3 for ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4! This powerful addition adds 6 new playable characters across 2 DLC packs, each bringing fresh abilities and iconic moves to the battlefield.

Includes:
• Character Pack 7: To be released around Q4 2025
- Lucci -CP0- + Costume
- New Playable Character + Costume
- New Playable Character + Costume
• Character Pack 8: Special Selection: To be released around Q1 2026
- Eneru
- King
- Z
• Shanks Additional Special Move "Divine Departure" (Character Pass 3 Bonus)

*The products in Character Pass 3 are also sold separately.
*Shanks Additional Special Move "Divine Departure" can be used by the playable characters Shanks or Shanks (Film: Red).
